title: Part (3 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.375. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a single face, which includes a single loop and a single circle. Position the center of the circle at coordinates (0.0417, 0.0417) and set the radius to 0.0417. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0834. Apply the transformation using the previously defined coordinate system. Extrude the scaled sketch 0.375 units along the normal direction to form a solid cylindrical base. The dimensions of this first part are 0.0833625065639769 in length, 0.0833625065639769 in width, and 0.375 in height.

For the second part, create another coordinate system with the same Euler angles and translation vector. On a single face, draw a single loop and a single circle with the center at (0.0417, 0.0417) and a radius of 0.0417. Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0834 and apply the transformation. Extrude the sketch 0.375 units in the opposite direction of the normal, adding this extrusion to the existing cylindrical body. The dimensions of this second part are identical to the first part: 0.0833625065639769 in length, 0.0833625065639769 in width, and 0.375 in height.

For the third part, repeat the process of creating a new coordinate system with the same Euler angles and translation vector. On a single face, draw a single loop and a single circle with the center at (0.0417, 0.0417) and a radius of 0.0417. Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.0834 and apply the transformation. Extrude the sketch 0.1313 units along the normal direction, adding this extrusion to the existing body. The dimensions of this third part are 0.0833625065639769 in length, 0.0833625065639769 in width, and 0.13127953789602662 in height.

The final shape consists of a cylindrical object with a flat top and bottom, parallel to each other, and a uniform diameter throughout its length. The total height of the final shape is 0.88127953789602662, while the length and width remain consistent at 0.0833625065639769.

reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first part of the cylinder
part_1 = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0417, 0.0417)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0417)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.375)  # Extrude the circle to create the first part of the cylinder
    .translate((0, 0, 0.375))  # Translate the part to the specified position
)

# Create the second part of the cylinder
part_2 = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0417, 0.0417)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0417)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(-0.375)  # Extrude the circle in the opposite direction
    .translate((0, 0, 0.375))  # Translate the part to the specified position
)

# Create the third part of the cylinder
part_3 = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0417, 0.0417)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0417)  # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.1313)  # Extrude the circle to create the third part of the cylinder
    .translate((0, 0, 0.375))  # Translate the part to the specified position
)

# Combine all parts to form the final cylinder
r = part_1.union(part_2).union(part_3)
